evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: Fresh Node 26.4.0 recomputation of apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/fixtures/nycartc-retrievable-population.json found 3,123 unique URLs: 608 account originals, 77 account replies, and 2,438 externally authored source statuses surfaced through native reposts. It separately reproduced 2 self-repost appearances, 2,440 total native-repost appearances, and 15 quote-post reply-inheritance corrections retained as originals.

The engagement computation reproduced exactly 618 of 685 account-authored originals/replies with at least one displayed reply, repost, or like. It reproduced 118 replies, 1,490 reposts, and 2,698 likes for 4,306 interaction units. The fixture's 65 bookmarks and 152,536 displayed views are excluded from both the 618-record predicate and the interaction-unit total.

scripts/lib/nycac-mission-classifier.mjs limits inputs to source-post body, hashtags, and displayed link destinations while excluding profile chrome and quoted-card content. All six fixture rule counts reproduced, and all retained positive evidence matched its checked-in rule.

Authenticated live checks covered all six mission signals across originals, replies, and externally authored source statuses, plus both self-repost source URLs and quote-post correction https://x.com/NYCArtC/status/1621553786790596609. Visible authorship, dates, matched phrases, and quote-card structure agreed with the public-safe metadata.

OBS-SOCIAL-NYCAC-RETRIEVABLE-POPULATION, OBS-SOCIAL-NYCAC-PUBLISHING-PATTERN, CLM-NYCAC-SOCIAL-INFRASTRUCTURE, and CLM-NYCAC-COUNCIL-SOCIAL-ENGAGEMENT distinguish source authorship, timeline appearance, direct mentions, conversation context, engagement, source-post chronology, endorsement, causality, and impact.

CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE and CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY name Jamie's direct actions. CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW and CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-REPLACED-BY-CURE separately preserve coalition, Council, agency, advocate, and mayoral credit and reject individual causality.

RT-SOCIAL-NYCAC-OWNER-ARCHIVE is critical and blocked on the account-owner archive. It explicitly treats the 2,001-record remainder as unmaterialized rather than absent or deleted and prevents claiming literal recovery of all 5,124 profile-counted posts.

Fresh deterministic verification reproduced the supplied fingerprint, reported zero validation errors, and scored KD-013 at 4. All 31 knowledge-development tests, 11 citation tests, 14 application-contract tests, and lint passed under Node 26.
findings: No material collective-credit or causality defect was found.

Standalone public status URLs verify source-status identity but cannot independently reproduce a profile timeline's prior self-repost-card appearance. The candidate preserves that distinction and attributes appearance evidence to the captured timeline metadata.

Displayed engagement is explicitly a dated, volatile interface snapshot. Observed live count drift therefore does not invalidate the accurately timestamped computation or become a reach or impact claim.
evals.recommended_next_move: Pass KD-006. Preserve the current boundaries and rerun the checked-in classifier and reconciliation before changing any count or attribution if the owner archive becomes available.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx leads with Jamie's actor-led professional value: founding participation, campaign-web infrastructure, a six-part operating plan, 30+ pages of shared campaign memory, a legislative provenance redline, public-data implementation design, action tracking, organizing, and Council testimony.

apps/www/src/data/work.ts identifies concrete artifacts and what became usable, including the operating plan, consent-aware shared memory, provenance redline, attributed working draft, privacy-preserving data requirements, public testimony, and an auditable policy trail.

CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE and CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY provide specific direct action. CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW and CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-REPLACED-BY-CURE present credible institutional outcomes without claiming Jamie caused them.

The hiring-facing CLM-NYCAC-SOCIAL-INFRASTRUCTURE paragraph remains concise: it names six operating functions and the 3,123 retrievable records without inserting the full taxonomy or 2,001-record recovery mechanics. Its exact citation resolves to SRC-SOCIAL-NYCAC-RETRIEVABLE-POPULATION-2026-07-14 plus the two X platform-boundary sources.

The cited source note states the 5,124 profile count and 2,001-record owner-archive dependency, while its linked fixture preserves the complete 608-original, 77-reply, 2,438-external-repost, quote-post, self-repost, chronology, engagement, and mission-taxonomy mechanics. The concise projection and detailed evidence boundary are therefore exact.

High-value unresolved research is prioritized rather than promoted: RT-SOCIAL-NYCAC-OWNER-ARCHIVE is critical/blocked, RT-SOCIAL-NYCAC-ACCOUNT-ESTABLISHMENT-CORROBORATION is high/open, RT-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION is critical/in-progress, and RT-NYCAC-FIREGUARD-PASS-RATE-CORROBORATION is high/open.

Fresh citation validation confirmed that the public registry is current and redacted and that social-media claims resolve through it. Application-contract tests confirmed actor-led Chad-lens proof and concise governance on case studies.
findings: The case study makes Jamie legible as a technical project and product-operations actor while retaining collaborators and institutions as distinct actors.
The public page does not expose the 618 engagement metric or the full archival mechanics, so the hiring narrative is not drowned in corpus detail.
No material hiring-legibility or overclaiming defect was found.

The initial workspace typecheck could not write tsconfig.tsbuildinfo because the holdout is read-only; this was an environment limitation. The required rerun with --incremental false passed with exit code 0.
evals.recommended_next_move: Pass KD-012. Keep the current projection concise and strengthen it only when the prioritized owner-archive, account-establishment, Office-creation, or Fireguard research produces new defensible evidence.
